sources.entry: JustMD - Native Markdown editor with hidden syntax, a rendered reading mode, and PDF export.

summary.one_liner: A free, open-source native macOS Markdown editor that hides syntax off the active line and offers a rendered Read mode with PDF export.
summary.what_it_does: JustMD opens .md files in a native document window and hides Markdown markers on every line except the one being edited. Links display their text, lists show real bullets, and horizontal rules render as hairlines. A Read mode (⇧⌘E) renders tables, clickable checkboxes, and local images. Documents are saved as ordinary files with autosave, undo, and macOS file versions. Users can print the rendered document or export it as PDF, and choose built-in themes or import and export custom ones.
use_cases: editing Markdown notes on a Mac
previewing rendered Markdown with tables and checkboxes
exporting a Markdown document to PDF
writing Markdown without seeing raw syntax
customizing editor themes for Markdown files
how_to_run: In Signing & Capabilities, select 'Sign to Run Locally' for the app and test targets, then press ⌘R
xcodebuild -project JustMD/JustMD.xcodeproj -scheme JustMD -destination 'platform=macOS' -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData DEVELOPMENT_TEAM= CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=- build
notable: Markdown markers hide on all lines except the active paragraph
Read mode renders real NSTextTable grids, checkboxes, and inline local images
Custom themes exported and imported as .justmd-theme JSON
No account, upload, or sync; files stay on the local Mac
Builds locally with ad-hoc signing without maintainer credentials
caveats: Requires macOS 14 (Sonoma) or later and Xcode 26.3+ to build
Known limitations include remote images, large-document resizing, and table editing
Master branch contains unreleased 1.1 work (newsletter signup, in-app coffee purchase) not in the 1.0 release
